Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Looksy assistant character redesign concept. The user liked the tangible CGI rendering quality of an earlier proposal but rejected its camera-eyed optical-robot character design. Design a substantially different original character. Aim for the sophistication of a theatrical animated feature: appealing sculptural silhouette, believable dimensional anatomy, expressive acting, carefully groomed or authored surfaces, physically based material response, rich but controlled lighting, convincing contact shadows and weight. Full-body beauty render, one character only, three-quarter front view, square composition, entire silhouette and feet visible with safe margins, almost fills image. Seamless dark charcoal studio floor/backdrop. Large soft warm key, cool gentle fill, narrow soft rim. Character in sharp focus, natural portrait lens perspective. No text, logos, labels, panel borders, props, cameras, monitor faces, screen eyes, lens eyes, neon glow, scanlines, flat vector shading, outlines or recognizable existing movie characters. Personality should feel intelligent, observant, quietly funny, with an independent spark rather than babyish cuteness or a bland stock mascot.
Direction A — furry studio companion. A small original marten-like creature with a compact pear-shaped charcoal-furred body, large softly triangular ears swept slightly backward, a short expressive muzzle, a subtle asymmetric ivory patch running from one cheek into the throat, and a thick tapering tail curved around behind the feet as a sculptural counterbalance. Broad dexterous little paws with four short fingers, grounded hind feet, no human clothes or accessories. Rich meticulously groomed dark graphite fur with longer silky guard hairs catching the rim light and velvety lighter fur around the muzzle; delicate warm amber irises with real corneal depth, small dark nose. Head is substantial but not oversized, face angular enough to suggest an experienced clever adult creature. A sly thoughtful half-smile, one eyebrow slightly raised, head tipped toward the viewer. Relaxed attentive posture with one hand palm-up, as though it has noticed a useful detail. Charcoal and warm ivory fur, subtle natural warm brown at ear interiors. Design the actual body and face with memorable asymmetry and believable structure; avoid a generic fox, big plush baby eyes, red fur, costumes or an on-the-nose photographer mascot.
